decks.notes: This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through counterspells and removal spells like Fatal Push. It also utilizes graveyard interaction with cards like Thought Scour and Unearth. The creatures in the deck, such as Abhorrent Oculus and Psychic Frog, provide additional ways to control the board. The land base is optimized for fetching the necessary colors of mana and also includes utility lands like Undercity Sewers. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent by controlling the game and grinding out a win.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to use efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to apply pressure early on, while also having access to powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and static Prison to control the board. With the support of cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ocelot Pride, the deck aims to close out the game quickly by dealing damage to the opponent and securing victory.

The deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, including The One Ring and Malevolent Rumble, in order to quickly assemble a powerful combo win condition. The inclusion of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and control elements, while cards like Spell Snare and Boseiju, Who Endures help protect the combo pieces. Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber provide additional ways to generate mana and delve deeper into the deck. Ultimately, the goal is to efficiently and effectively combo off to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach as a key combo piece to continuously cast spells from the graveyard, while also leveraging cards that untap lands like Deserted Temple and Lotus Field to generate mana. Other cards like Consign to Memory and Dream's Grip are used for disruption, while Wishclaw+Talisman','','');">Wishclaw Talisman provides tutor ability. Thassa's Oracle serves as a win condition by either decking opponents or winning with its triggered ability. The deck aims to speedily assemble the combo pieces and disrupt opponents long enough to secure a win.

This deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal, and creature threats. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Sink into Stupor and Thought Scour, while also protecting its own threats with counterspells like Force of Negation and Counterspell. The deck also utilizes efficient removal like Fatal Push and Unearth to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to take control of the game and eventually close it out with powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Harbinger of the Seas.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of spells and creatures to quickly set up a powerful win condition without relying on traditional lands. By combining disruptive elements with mana acceleration and card advantage, the deck aims to assemble key pieces and combo off with cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Waterlogged Teachings to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and proactive, aiming to win the game before the opponent can establish a strong board presence or find a way to disrupt the combo.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on a strong aggressive strategy, utilizing efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes spell support like Galvanic Discharge and Exorcise to remove threats and push through damage. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds flexibility to the deck, allowing for additional resources. The deck aims to maintain board control through cards like Static Prison while also having a strong finisher in Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. Overall, this deck is designed to apply constant pressure and close out games quickly.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on generating aggression quickly and efficiently, utilizing a combination of powerful creatures like Amped Raptor and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, as well as removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Static Prison to control the board, while leveraging the mana acceleration provided by Jegantha, the Wellspring. With a strong mana base and versatile cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of speed, power, and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing a wide range of creatures to assemble powerful combinations that allow for control and disruption of the opponent's strategy. By carefully selecting and utilizing creatures like Malevolent Rumble, Grist, the Hunger Tide, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck can manipulate the battlefield and generate incremental advantages over time. The inclusion of support cards like Shadowspear, Nihil Spellbomb, and Agatha's Soul Cauldron further enhances the deck's ability to disrupt opposing strategies and create advantageous board states. Ultimately, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a versatile toolbox of creatures and disruption spells.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures and burn spells. It utilizes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Lightning Bolt to control the board and deal direct damage, while creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Amped Raptor provide aggressive threats. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. By combining aggressive creatures with burn spells and strong finishers, the Boros Aggro deck aims to swiftly defeat the opponent before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, backed up by powerful support cards to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The strategy revolves around utilizing efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Static Prison and Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Arena of Glory provide additional power and resilience to the aggro strategy. Additionally, the use of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds a versatile and consistent mana source to help maintain the deck's tempo.

The main concept of this Naya Zoo aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck focuses on quick, powerful creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, while also utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Malevolent Rumble to control the board and deal damage directly to the opponent. The inclusion of Saffi Eriksdotter and Renegade Rallier allows for recursion and value generation, while cards like Static Prison and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional disruption and pressure. The deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively through a combination of aggression and versatility.

The core concept of this Ruby Storm deck is to utilize cards that reduce mana costs and generate mana, allowing for quick and explosive combo plays. By casting spells such as Pyretic Ritual, Manamorphose, and Reckless Impulse, players can generate mana and draw cards to fuel their combo. Past in Flames and Ral, Monsoon Mage help to recur key spells from the graveyard, while cards like Wish provide additional utility. The goal is to quickly build up a storm count and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells to secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays that overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds extra versatility to the deck. Cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison help control the board while cards like Guide of Souls and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide card advantage and additional aggression. The deck aims to win through fast, decisive attacks.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly flood the board with aggressive creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Amped Raptor, supported by cards like Lightning Bolt and Goblin Bombardment for direct damage. The deck also focuses on controlling the opponent's board with cards like Static Prison and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional resilience and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays while maintaining control of the battlefield.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly to play powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the board with spells like Kozilek's Command and Ugin's Labyrinth. The deck focuses on accelerating mana production with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple, and then using these resources to play devastating threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Sire of Seven Deaths. The control aspect of the deck comes from cards like Malevolent Rumble and All Is Dust, which help to clear the opponent's board and maintain dominance throughout the game.
